1.visual: A barcode consisting of several evenly spaced vertical black bars of uniform height. There are no numbers beneath the bars — it reads as a classic linear product barcode stripped to its essential pattern.
1.usage: Product detail pages showing a scannable barcode, inventory management item lookup, point-of-sale product scanning UI, barcode label printing workflows.

2.visual: A three-dimensional cube rendered with clean outline strokes — a top diamond face and two visible side faces give it a 3D isometric appearance. The faces are empty with no markings or labels.
2.usage: Product packaging or 3D model representation, order shipment detail for a generic product unit, augmented reality or 3D viewer toggle, inventory item icon.

3.visual: A credit card depicted as a rounded rectangle with a single horizontal stripe across the upper portion, representing the magnetic stripe or card number area. The card has a simple, flat outline style with no chip or logo.
3.usage: Payment method selection, saved cards list, checkout billing information form, add or manage payment methods screen.

4.visual: A wrapped gift box with a ribbon tied into a bow on top. The box body has clean rectangular sides and the bow forms two symmetrical loops at the center of the lid.
4.usage: Gift wrapping option at checkout, wishlist or gift registry feature, promotional gift-with-purchase offer, sending a gift to another person.

5.visual: A three-dimensional box/package rendered with isometric outline strokes, similar to icon 2 but with a visible horizontal line across the front face indicating a sealed parcel or shipping box. The top face and two sides are visible.
5.usage: Shipment tracking, order packaging status, warehouse or fulfillment workflow, product inventory item.

6.visual: An open box viewed from above and slightly in front, with the four top flaps folded outward to reveal the open interior. The isometric outline shows the box body and splayed lid panels clearly.
6.usage: Unboxing or unpacking an order, open/received shipment status, product returns or unpackaged items, 3D model or AR product preview.

7.visual: A receipt or paper bill depicted as a tall rounded rectangle with three short horizontal lines representing printed text and a wavy bottom edge simulating a torn or perforated receipt tail.
7.usage: View order receipt, transaction history detail, invoice or billing summary, print or download receipt action.

8.visual: A shopping bag depicted as a square rounded-corner outline with a small curved U-shaped handle cutout at the top center and a smile-like arc inside the lower half representing the bag interior or a fill line.
8.usage: Shopping bag or cart overview, saved items or favorites bag, fashion or retail storefront action, checkout bag contents.

9.visual: A shopping cart rendered as a wireframe outline: a large trapezoidal basket angled forward on two wheels, with a short vertical handle bar at the upper right. The two wheels are solid filled circles at the base.
9.usage: Add to cart action, view cart contents, e-commerce store navigation, checkout initiation.

10.visual: A storefront facade showing a wide awning along the top edge with three scalloped or arched decorative scallops, and a recessed doorway or shop entrance centered beneath it. The overall shape reads as a classic retail shop front.
10.usage: Marketplace or seller shop page, browse stores or vendors, merchant profile navigation, retail location or store finder.

11.visual: A single price tag shape — a rounded-corner pentagon (like a rectangular tag with a pointed left end) with a small circular hole punched near the point. The tag is shown rotated roughly 45 degrees.
11.usage: Product pricing display, apply a discount or coupon tag, label or categorize a product, promotional pricing highlight.

12.visual: Two overlapping price tags stacked at a slight offset, both sharing the same rounded-pentagon shape with a small hole near the pointed end. The second tag is visible behind and below the first.
12.usage: Multiple pricing tiers or sale tags, bulk discount labeling, compare prices feature, tags or labels management for multiple products.

13.visual: A ticket or voucher depicted as a horizontal rectangle with rounded ends and a small notch cut into each long side at the center, forming the classic perforation indent of a tear-off ticket. A colon-like pair of dots appears in the middle.
13.usage: Event ticket purchase or redemption, coupon or voucher code display, promo code field, digital ticket wallet.

14.visual: A delivery truck shown in side-profile outline: a large square cargo box on the left, a smaller raised cab on the right, and two solid circular wheels at the base. The silhouette is immediately recognizable as a shipping van or box truck.
14.usage: Shipping and delivery status, estimated delivery date display, choose a shipping method at checkout, track an outbound order.
